Population.evidence_source: The findings on academic failure paint a picture of students seeking an escape from what was experienced as an increasingly intolerable state of existence where the prospect of failure loomed large. Transitional periods in the academic year appeared key in providing a context for this state of mind. Three-quarters of the deaths occurred either at the beginning or at the end of the academic year. Parents' and friends' accounts described the inner psychic experience of the students as mirroring this external context of transition.

Area.evidence_source: The findings on academic failure paint a picture of students seeking an escape from what was experienced as an increasingly intolerable state of existence where the prospect of failure loomed large. Transitional periods in the academic year appeared key in providing a context for this state of mind. Parents' and friends' accounts described the inner psychic experience of the students as mirroring this external context of transition. The data depicted a state of mind which saw no prospect of returning to the previous year's existence but which characterised the future as threatening further failures: These transitional periods at the beginnings and ends of the academic year appeared to provide a context which fed into the students'sense of being trapped in a position that they found unendurable. ... The students in this study seemed, from the accounts of those who had known them well, to be seeking an escape from what they experienced as an intolerable situation and to be opting for suicide as a means of avoiding further failure and distress.
